scenes.voiceover: Microsoft just axed forty-eight hundred jobs. If you're on an H-1B visa, your clock just started ticking.

scenes.voiceover: Xbox is taking the biggest hit. Thirty-two hundred gaming roles gone. Four entire studios being sold off or shut down.
scenes.image_prompt: Xbox controller breaking apart, 3,200 jobs eliminated, studio names listed

scenes.image_prompt: Split screen stock chart down vs data center spending up, contrasting red and green

scenes.voiceover: For Indian H-1B workers, being laid off means sixty days. Sixty days to find a new sponsor or leave the country.
scenes.image_prompt: Hourglass countdown showing 60 DAYS, H-1B visa fading, urgent amber tones

scenes.voiceover: The cruel irony — Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta are the top H-1B sponsors AND the biggest job cutters. The same companies bringing workers in are pushing them out.
scenes.image_prompt: Venn diagram showing top H-1B sponsors overlapping with biggest job cutters

scenes.voiceover: If you're an Indian tech worker in America right now, update your LinkedIn, talk to immigration lawyers, and start your green card process today. Don't wait.
